Job Title: Lead Engineer – Thales (Cybersecurity & HSM Solutions)

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (On-site)

Job Type: Full-time

Seniority Level: Lead / Senior Level

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Lead Engineer – Thales (Cybersecurity & HSM Solutions) to join our project team in Riyadh. In this role, you will lead the architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation of enterprise-grade data protection, hardware security modules (HSMs), and key management systems using Thales technologies.

Key Responsibilities

• Architecture & Framework Integration: Architect and deploy enterprise-wide data encryption and access control frameworks, integrating Thales HSMs with databases (Oracle/MS SQL TDE), web servers (IIS, WebLogic, Tomcat), PAM, and PKI environments.
• HSM & CipherTrust Management: Manage and maintain Thales Luna, payShield, and CipherTrust Manager clusters; handle patch management, software updates, and overall appliance health with zero downtime.
• Audits & Security Compliance: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability assessments, and risk reviews. Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations (PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA).
• Monitoring & Incident Response: Oversee SIEM and log monitoring (Splunk, ELK) for anomaly detection, lead root-cause analysis, and refine alert thresholds for rapid incident response.
• Automation & Maintenance: Automate key-lifecycle tasks (key rotation, backups, provisioning, and retirement) using Ansible and REST APIs.
• Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional IT/Risk teams and third-party vendors to assess security gaps, integrate controls, and validate external SLAs.
Qualifications & Experience
• Experience: 3 years of hands-on experience in Cybersecurity, specializing in Data Protection, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), and Key Management.
• Thales Expertise:
• In-depth hands-on experience with Thales Luna HSM, payShield, and CipherTrust Data Security Platform.
• Strong mastery of cryptographic protocols, algorithms, and APIs (AES, RSA, PKCS#11, KMIP, CTE).
• Certifications (Preferred):
• Thales Certified Engineer / Administrator (Luna, payShield, High Speed Encryption, CipherTrust).
• Professional security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, or equivalent).
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electronics & Communications Engineering, or a related technical field.
What We Offer
• Competitive compensation package.
• High-impact opportunity working on critical national enterprise security projects.
• Collaborative and technology-driven work culture.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Engineer III - Security Operations based in Saudi Arabia.

Join a globally distributed engineering team focused on protecting critical cloud infrastructure and strengthening security operations within a modern payments environment. As a Security Engineer III, you will take ownership of key detection and response capabilities, helping identify emerging threats, investigate incidents, and improve security coverage. You will build and optimize SIEM detections, automate response workflows, and develop reliable security tooling using Python and infrastructure-as-code practices. Working across cloud infrastructure, compliance, and incident response, you will help reduce operational risk while making security processes more efficient. This role offers meaningful technical ownership, opportunities to improve security maturity, and collaboration with a team that values autonomy, continuous learning, and clear communication.
Accountabilities
• Plan and deliver end-to-end detection and response initiatives, from creating detection rules to implementing automated response workflows.
• Build, tune, and maintain security detections across Elastic SIEM and AWS environments, identifying and closing gaps in existing threat coverage.
• Manage the security investigation queue by triaging alerts, investigating suspicious activity, escalating incidents when necessary, and driving issues toward resolution.
• Document incident investigations and findings clearly to support follow-up actions, knowledge sharing, and operational consistency.
• Develop and maintain runbooks and automation workflows using Python and no-code tools such as Zapier or Tines to reduce manual work and accelerate incident response.
• Make and document risk decisions within your area of responsibility, escalating issues when additional expertise or support is required.
• Support compliance initiatives by maintaining audit-ready security controls and contributing evidence for frameworks such as SOC 2 and PCI DSS.
• Use Terraform and Python to build, maintain, and improve the infrastructure supporting security detections and operational tooling.
• Participate in the on-call rotation for security monitoring and incident response.
• Continuously improve detection coverage, investigation processes, and response efficiency.
Requirements

The ideal candidate has practical experience in security operations and cloud-native threat detection, with strong scripting skills and the ability to investigate incidents independently. You should be comfortable taking ownership of security outcomes while communicating findings and risks clearly.
• Hands‑on experience building, maintaining, and tuning SIEM detections. Experience with Elastic is preferred, while Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or comparable platforms is also relevant.
• Practical experience securing AWS environments and implementing cloud-native detection and response capabilities.
• Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and security tooling.
• Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code technologies.
• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to threat detection and investigation.
• Demonstrated experience triaging, investigating, and resolving security incidents.
• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document investigations, technical findings, and risk decisions in a clear, structured manner.
• Ability to work independently, prioritize security issues, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
• Willingness to participate in an on‑call rotation for monitoring and incident response.
Nice to have
• Experience with security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) platforms or no-code security automation tools.
• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.
• Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry.
